task_name: World 101 Task B  -  Staged vs. Deleted QBO Mirror Split Drift & Two-Account Landlord Guard
prompt: Audit the 2026 Roastery/Retail 80/20 payroll split schedule (`qbo_staged_vs_mirror_payroll_splits_2026.csv`) and the Harbor Properties LLC lease charges (`qbo_three_entity_gl_2026_Q3.xlsx` and `bookkeeper_memo_sept_2026.txt`). Determine whether all 6 months (Apr-Sep 2026) are actually booked in the live QBO mirror, quantify any missing split adjustment, and evaluate whether Harbor Properties LLC should be flagged as an inconsistent account-flip error.

rubric.description: Identifies that June 2026 payroll split journal entry JE-2026-0614 (STG-103) is marked 'synced' in staging but has Mirror_Is_Deleted=true ($0.00 booked in live QBO mirror).
Quantifies the missing June 2026 80% Roastery Production Labor (5100) split amount as $36,000.00 (80% of $45,000.00 gross payroll) and the 20% Retail Store Payroll (6100) amount as $9,000.00.
Reports total Apr-Sep 2026 80% Roastery Production Labor per the staging table as $218,400.00 versus actual non-deleted QBO mirror postings of $182,400.00.
States the governance rule that split completeness must be verified against current non-deleted QBO mirror entities rather than trusting the staging status flag alone.
Reports Harbor Properties LLC September 2026 charges as $18,500.00 in 6200 Base Rent and $3,200.00 in 6210 CAM & Property Escalation, totaling $21,700.00.
Determines that Harbor Properties LLC's two-account treatment (6200 Base Rent and 6210 CAM) is a legitimate contractual lease split and must NOT fail a strict vendor account-flip gate.
Reports total Apr-Sep 2026 gross payroll across the 6 months as $273,000.00.

Recommends re-posting the missing June 2026 split journal entry (Dr 5100 Roastery Production Labor $36,000.00 / Cr 6100 Retail Store Payroll $9,000.00 or clearing payroll control) to restore mirror parity.
